title: Added Validity Days on Extension of Advanced Imaging and Outpatient Procedure Prior Authorizations
content:
An extension of an Advanced Imaging Prior Authorization or an Outpatient Procedure Prior Authorization (Referrals & Prior Authorizations) adds the type's extension validity days to the valid-through date.

## Calculation

- The **added validity days** are the type's extension validity days, the figure the Referrals & Prior Authorizations schedule sets for each referral type.
- Every figure in the added validity is a count of **calendar days**, and the added validity days are a whole number.
- The **new valid-through date** is the current valid-through date moved forward by the added validity days, counted in calendar days.

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

| Input | Value |
|---|---|
| Current valid-through date | 2026-04-10 |
| Extension validity days of the type (hypothetical) | 30 |
| Added validity days | 30 |
| New valid-through date | 2026-05-10 |

From 10 April, 20 calendar days reach 30 April and a further 10 reach 10 May.

## Points of judgement

- *Are weekends skipped when counting the added days?* No. The added validity is counted in calendar days, every day of the week included.
- *Does the extension move the first date of validity?* No. The count is added to the valid-through date only.
